summary: Intelligent calendar drafts and more precise entity extraction

changes.title: Contextual calendar events
changes.detail: Recognize unambiguous ISO or English month-name dates, today/tomorrow and explicit times, ranges and short event titles. Timed events use local device time, default to a one-hour editable draft, and all-day dates use calendar UTC conventions. Ambiguous and invalid dates or repeated DST times are rejected.

changes.title: Focused entity extraction
changes.detail: Rank specific email, link and tracking entities before other supported details; suppress ambiguous numeric phone fragments. Keep masked explicit selection, original copy receipt, expiry and privacy checks.
